evals.name: Structured JSON Logging & Recursive PII Redaction
evals.prompt: Configure an enterprise logging system for an order processing service that outputs single-line structured JSON logs with correlationId and automatically redacts passwords, tokens, and credit card numbers.
evals.expected_output: Configures a structured JSON logger emitting mandatory fields (timestamp, level, service, correlationId, message) and recursive PII redaction without raw console.log.
assertions: Replaces raw console.log with a dedicated structured JSON logger
Includes mandatory baseline fields: timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC), level, service, correlationId, and message
Applies recursive sanitization replacing passwords, bearer tokens, and PANs with [REDACTED]
Emits single-line JSON logs to stdout for high-throughput stream ingestion

evals.name: Prometheus RED Metrics Instrumentation & Cardinality Protection
evals.prompt: Implement Prometheus RED metrics middleware for an API gateway that records http_requests_total, errors_total, and http_request_duration_seconds at /metrics while preventing metric cardinality explosion.
evals.expected_output: Instruments Rate, Errors, and Duration metrics in Prometheus format using parameterized route templates to prevent cardinality explosion.
assertions: Instruments Rate (http_requests_total) counter partitioned by method, route, and status
Instruments Duration (http_request_duration_seconds) histogram with standard latency buckets for p50/p90/p99
Strictly uses parameterized route templates (:id) rather than raw URLs to prevent cardinality explosion
Exposes standard Prometheus scrape endpoint at /metrics

evals.name: Distributed Tracing via OpenTelemetry & W3C Propagation
evals.prompt: Set up OpenTelemetry distributed tracing in a microservice handling payment transactions, ensuring outbound HTTP calls propagate W3C traceparent headers and database queries are wrapped in active child spans.
evals.expected_output: Initializes OpenTelemetry NodeSDK, instruments child spans for critical operations, and propagates W3C traceparent headers across boundaries.
assertions: Initializes OpenTelemetry tracer with appropriate service identification and exporter
Wraps database operations or downstream calls in named active child spans with startActiveSpan
Propagates or extracts W3C traceparent context headers across network boundaries
Records exception telemetry and sets span status to ERROR upon unhandled failure
